advancement.wandering_earth.lighter.desc: 取得一枚火石，重启行星发动机。
Obtain a Lighter Stone and relight an engine.
advancement.wandering_earth.proxima.desc: 望向 4.2 光年外的新太阳。
Look toward the new sun, 4.2 light-years away.
advancement.wandering_earth.root.desc: 开始建造流浪地球的一切。
Begin building everything from The Wandering Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.ark_plan_terminal: A terminal for the American Ark project. It was never revived after the Ark station fell at Libreville in 2044.
lore.wandering_earth.ark_station_block: The Ark space station at the top of the elevator (film 2). It fell in the 2044 Space Elevator Crisis.
lore.wandering_earth.artificial_sun_lamp: A lamp that pretends to be the Sun.
lore.wandering_earth.astronaut_badge: An astronaut badge. In 2058, three hundred people over fifty wore theirs to the Moon.
lore.wandering_earth.atmosphere_vent: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.cabin_seat: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.cargo_container: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.civilization_archiv: The civilisation archive: what the Ark and the Navigator carry away is the record of human civilisation.
lore.wandering_earth.counterweight: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.delhi_digital_life_: The old Delhi institute where the Digital Life plan began. After it was banned by law, only the dead servers were left.
lore.wandering_earth.digital_life_lab_ru: The Digital Life laboratory. Tu Hengyu worked here, until he chose to upload his daughter's consciousness into 550W.
lore.wandering_earth.digital_life_plan_p: The pass of the Digital Life plan. It stopped meaning anything the day the UEG wrote the plan into law as permanently forbidden.
lore.wandering_earth.digital_life_termin: A terminal of the Digital Life Project - which the UEG permanently banned by law.
lore.wandering_earth.district_sign_beiji: 道路千万条，安全第一条；行车不规范，亲人两泪流。
lore.wandering_earth.elevator_cabin: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.elevator_cable: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.elevator_defense_tu: Space Elevator Crisis: drones from the Libreville base attacked the elevator cabins.
lore.wandering_earth.elevator_rail: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.elevator_wreckage: A component of the space elevator.
lore.wandering_earth.emergency_plan_boar: The board marked Emergency Plan No.3. When the plan started, humanity had less than two weeks.
lore.wandering_earth.emergency_plan_manu: The UEG's third plan: lay every one of humanity's 3,371 nuclear bombs across the surface of the moon.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_control_pane: A UEG control console. It registers every engine inside its scan radius and drives them all from one redstone line.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_hint: Right-click with a lighter stone to load it. It only fires while powered by redstone. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to turn the nozzle.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_light_pillar: A plasma column. In 2075 three engines fired, but their jets fell five thousand kilometres short of Jupiter.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_mountain_bas: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_number_plate: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_status_monit: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.engine_undercity: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.equatorial_turning_: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.exoskeleton_frame: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.fire_seed_civilizat: The record of human civilisation that MOSS carried away when it authorised the Fire Seed plan on its own in 2075.
lore.wandering_earth.fire_seed_plan_core: In 2075 MOSS concluded the plan had failed 0.42 seconds after Emergency Plan No.3 began, then authorised the Fire Seed plan on its own, carrying the record of human civilisation away.
lore.wandering_earth.fire_seed_plan_mark: Project Fire Seed - authorised by MOSS itself, not by the UEG.
lore.wandering_earth.frozen_ground: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.gagarin_era_plaque: A plaque from Gagarin's era. Russia's crewed Moon landings led the Lunar Exile Project.
lore.wandering_earth.hanzi_hao_vehicle_c: Han Zi'ang's vehicle card. Liu Qi used it to steal a hauler and drive up to the surface.
lore.wandering_earth.hauler_drive_ball: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.heavy_fusion_reacto: A heavy-nuclei fusion pile - stone is the fuel. In 2053 it powered seven thousand engines.
lore.wandering_earth.heavy_hauler: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.helium_flash_beacon: A helium-flash beacon. Fu Jianming forecast it in 1977 within four hundred years; in 2078 it came.
lore.wandering_earth.ice_crust: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.ignition_core: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.iteration_console: The iteration console: where Tu Yaya's consciousness was iterated more than nine hundred times.
lore.wandering_earth.jining_police_stati: In 2075 Liu Qi was held here after stealing a hauler, until Jupiter's gravity suddenly increased.
lore.wandering_earth.jupiter_gravity_ind: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.jupiter_great_red_s: Jupiter crisis (2075): the Roche limit closes in and the atmosphere is siphoned away.
lore.wandering_earth.li_yiyi_toolbox: The toolbox of hauler technician Li Yiyi, who drove with Han Duoduo and Liu Qi to save Sulawesi No.3.
lore.wandering_earth.lighter_socket: Insert a Lighter Core to relight a planetary engine.
lore.wandering_earth.lighter_transport_r: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.lottery_terminal: The lottery decides who enters the undercity: half of humanity won, the rest stayed on the surface.
lore.wandering_earth.lunar_nuke: The backup plan for the Moon: 3,371 nukes on the lunar surface, detonated as a phased array.
lore.wandering_earth.lunar_rover: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.lunar_satellite_eng: Three engines on the lunar surface, part of the Moon-by-Moon plan. 1.7 seconds after Tu Hengyu uploaded his daughter's consciousness, all three overloaded and exploded.
lore.wandering_earth.lunar_surface_regol: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.magma_flood: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.manual_detonator: "Those over fifty, step forward!" - Zhang Peng
lore.wandering_earth.moon_by_moon_termin: A terminal for the Russian Moon-by-Moon plan, which became the lunar satellite engine sub-plan of Project Wandering Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.moon_engine_platfor: The construction platform for the lunar satellite engines, a foundation left behind in the moon dust.
lore.wandering_earth.moon_nuke_array: 2058 fallback plan: 3,371 nuclear bombs laid out on the moon as a phased array, waiting to be detonated together.
lore.wandering_earth.moon_nuke_placement: The placement chart for 3,371 bombs on the moon. Liu Peiqiang placed the last five.
lore.wandering_earth.moon_return_capsule: The return capsule left by Russia's first moon landing. Zhang Peng had a foreign colleague tell Liu Peiqiang to take it back to the station.
lore.wandering_earth.moss_camera: A calm red dot. Probabilities first, conclusions later, and never an exclamation mark.
lore.wandering_earth.navigator_iss_contr: The Navigator ISS control module. Here Liu Peiqiang shut down the fire system and burned MOSS's core node with Makarov's vodka, taking back control.
lore.wandering_earth.navigator_iss_modul: A module of the Navigator ISS, responsible for early warning, navigation and communications, and eventually a fireball in the Jupiter crisis.
lore.wandering_earth.navigator_station_b: The Navigator space station, flying alongside the Earth (film 1). Begun in 2048; MOSS is its commander.
lore.wandering_earth.over_fifty_roster: Lunar Fall crisis: three hundred astronauts over fifty volunteered to detonate the nukes by hand.
lore.wandering_earth.panel_hint: Place near your engines to register them. Sneak-right-click cycles the radius (8 / 16 / 32). Power the panel to fire every registered engine at once.
lore.wandering_earth.planetary_engine_ca: One of the 10,000 Earth Engines of the Moving Mountain Project: heavy-nuclei fusion, burning stone to push the Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.planetary_engine_co: The heart of a Mountain-Moving engine.
lore.wandering_earth.planetary_engine_no: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.plasma_beam_emitter: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.proxima_centauri_ch: Alpha Centauri, 4.2 light-years away. In the novel it is 2,500 years, a hundred generations.
lore.wandering_earth.quantum_computer_55: 550 series quantum computer. The carrier of Tu Yaya's consciousness: 900+ iterations, two minutes of life.
550 series quantum computer. Only three 550C existed; the one Ma Zhao took to the Moon was destroyed by a Z9 solar storm.
The 550W, developed in 2051, renamed MOSS in 2058. Read it backwards.
lore.wandering_earth.robot_dog_benben: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.root_server_access_: The key needed to restart the global root servers. The decryption still needed at least 714 hours.
lore.wandering_earth.root_server_beijing: One of the three global internet root servers. When the moon's wreckage fell, seawater flooded the hall and Ma Zhao and Tu Hengyu drowned here.
lore.wandering_earth.root_server_dulles: The third root server, in Dulles, Virginia - the last of the three that had to come back within half an hour.
lore.wandering_earth.root_server_tokyo: One of the three global internet root servers. After the moon broke up, it had to be back online within half an hour.
lore.wandering_earth.seed_vault: Project Fire Seed: the escape-with-our-civilisation-records plan MOSS authorised on its own in 2075.
lore.wandering_earth.singularity_data_co: 550 series / MOSS hardware. The films have no 'Israeli singularity'; this is only a cabinet name.
lore.wandering_earth.snow_drift: The hostile sky and frozen Earth.
lore.wandering_earth.space_elevator_base: The cable to space - the Space Elevator Crisis of 2044. The base was at Libreville, Gabon.
lore.wandering_earth.stone_burner: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.sulawesi_turning_en: In the 2075 Jupiter crisis it was reprogrammed to ignite Jupiter's atmosphere; the plasma stream still fell five thousand kilometres short.
lore.wandering_earth.thrust_engine: A block of the Mountain Moving Project.
lore.wandering_earth.tower_crane: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.tu_yaya_data_core: Tu Yaya's data: two minutes of life, iterated more than nine hundred times; 70 years once uploaded to 550W.
lore.wandering_earth.tu_yaya_memory_chip: Tu Yaya's perfect memory stored as a chip: she typed out 30,000 digits of the password in front of 550W.
lore.wandering_earth.tunnel_boring_machi: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.uav_drone: Machines that crossed the frozen surface.
lore.wandering_earth.ueg_flag: The United Earth Government (UEG) - the United Nations, reorganised.
lore.wandering_earth.undercity_entrance: Enter by winning the lottery. The films say half of humanity went underground, mostly by lottery.
lore.wandering_earth.zhou_ignition_butto: The moment Zhou Zhezhi spoke at the UEG: "Our people will get it done, real or not, at any cost."
message.wandering_earth.alert: UEG level-4 alert: helium flash warning / gravity crisis.
message.wandering_earth.engine: UEG works department: engine nominal, awaiting the ignition order.
message.wandering_earth.engine_empty: No lighter left. The engine has gone out.
message.wandering_earth.engine_loaded: Lighter Core loaded (%s / %s). Connect a redstone signal to fire the beam.
message.wandering_earth.engine_needs_red: The engine holds a Lighter Core but has no ignition signal. Connect a redstone line.
message.wandering_earth.ignition: Zhou Zhezhi: Our people will get it done, real or not, at any cost.
message.wandering_earth.lottery_lose: We are sorry - you did not win this round. Please wait on the surface for the next lottery.
message.wandering_earth.lottery_win: Congratulations - you have won a place in the undercity, with one immediate family member.
message.wandering_earth.panel_on: Ignition signal pushed to the registered engines.
message.wandering_earth.panel_rescanned: Scanned a radius of %s and registered %s engines.
message.wandering_earth.traffic: Beijing District 3 Traffic Committee reminds you: many roads, safety first.
wandering_earth.ponder.lighter_socket.te: Lighter stones are the engine's fuel; loose ones nearby are pulled in.
The heavy fusion reactor burns stone and exhales plasma.
Drop a Lighter Stone into the socket and the engine lights.
Sneak with an empty hand and right-click to turn the nozzle.
